All eight selected chapters are returned exactly once and reviewed only within the supplied ten-lens chapter scope. The dossier has meaningful independent evidence but does not achieve full saturation or uniformly fair attribution. Chapter 7B has the most serious substantive limitation because personal integrity requires a personal nexus that the notebook does not establish. Chapters 1B, 3B, 4B, 5B, 6B, and 8B retain material operational, attribution, execution, or temporal gaps; Chapter 2B is dominated by official positions and incomplete independent resolution of key disputes.
